checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on — REQUIRED per deployment (e.g. repos/product).

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.

base_ref.description: Base ref audit/fix worktrees are cut from and PRs target.

worktree_base.description: State + worktree root — MUST be absolute (ops params get no shell $HOME expansion). Holds cursor, audited/ stamps, slices/*.findings.json ledgers, current-slice, current-finding.json, run-token, sessions/, cleanup-ledger.jsonl, audit-current/ and fix-current/ worktrees.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for audit/fix sessions.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create — REQUIRED for unattended runs ('bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' is the safer middle ground).

slices.description: Slice manifest: 'id=path1,path2;id2=...' — repo-relative path prefixes the audit agent scopes to. Round-robin via cursor file; override per deployment or per run via `campaign submit --config`.

rescan_days.description: A slice whose audited stamp is younger than this many days is skipped by the picker (0 = always eligible).

max_findings_per_slice.description: Cap on findings kept per slice ledger — resolved entries always kept; pending fill remaining slots severity-sorted.

max_fix_attempts.description: Per-finding fix attempts across ALL runs — durable in the slice findings ledger; exhausted findings are marked failed.

max_fixes_per_run.description: Per-run cap on findings processed — bounds one manual run's agent+verify cost.

verify_cmd.description: Verification command run in the fix worktree after bun install — appended to the agent-reported changed-file list as `bunx vp check <files>`-style scoped args is NOT automatic: this is the base command; the node runs `<verify_cmd> <changed files>`.

e2e_mode.description: auto = run e2e only when changed files match e2e_path_prefixes; always; never.

e2e_path_prefixes.description: Comma-separated repo-relative prefixes that trigger e2e under e2e_mode=auto.

e2e_cmd.description: E2E command run from apps/web when triggered (playwright config starts its own dev server).
